title: Billing dispute process
text: Customers can dispute any postpaid bill charge within 30 days of the bill date. A billing complaint is resolved within 3 working days (72 hours). Disputed amounts above Rs 5,000 are reviewed by a billing supervisor. Customers should pay the undisputed part of the bill by the due date to avoid suspension.

title: Refunds and adjustments
text: If a charge is found incorrect, the amount is adjusted as a credit in the next bill for postpaid customers, or refunded to the original payment method within 7 working days for prepaid customers. The chatbot cannot approve refunds; only the billing team can, after investigation.

title: Late payment fee
text: A late payment fee of Rs 100 is applied when a postpaid bill is unpaid 3 days after the due date. Services are suspended 15 days after the due date and restored within 4 hours of payment. Fee waivers need billing supervisor approval.

title: Recharge not credited
text: If money is debited but the recharge is not credited, wait 2 hours as most cases auto-reverse or auto-credit. After 2 hours, raise a complaint with the UPI or bank reference number. Failed recharge amounts are refunded to the source within 5 to 7 working days.

title: Network and call drop troubleshooting
text: Basic checks: restart the phone, toggle airplane mode, check that network mode is set to 4G/5G auto, and try the SIM in another phone. If the problem continues at a fixed location, raise a technical complaint with the area or pin code. Technical complaints are resolved within 48 hours, or a field visit is scheduled.

title: Mobile data not working or slow
text: Check remaining data balance and plan validity first. Reset the APN to 'nimbusnet' in mobile network settings and restart the phone. Speeds may be reduced after the daily high-speed data limit is used. Known area outages are shown on the Nimbus network status page.

title: SIM replacement and lost SIM
text: To block a lost or stolen SIM immediately, call 198 from any Nimbus number or speak to an agent. A replacement SIM is issued at a Nimbus store after original photo ID verification; the old SIM's services stop within 4 hours of the swap. Nimbus will never ask for OTPs over chat or phone.

title: Mobile Number Portability (port out)
text: To port out, SMS 'PORT <10-digit number>' to 1900 to receive a Unique Porting Code (UPC). Postpaid customers must clear outstanding dues before porting.

title: Spam calls and DND
text: Customers can activate Do Not Disturb (DND) by calling or sending an SMS to 1909. Spam or fraud calls can be reported to Nimbus through this chatbot; suspected financial fraud should also be reported on the national cybercrime helpline 1930.

title: International roaming
text: International roaming is off by default for prepaid users and must be activated before travel. Postpaid users with roaming enabled are charged per the active IR pack; usage without a pack is charged at standard pay-as-you-go roaming rates.

title: Complaint resolution timelines and escalation
text: Nimbus resolution targets: Technical 48 hours, Billing 72 hours, Other 5 working days. If a customer is not satisfied with the resolution, they can request escalation to a human agent and then to the Nimbus Appellate Officer. Every complaint gets a ticket ID for tracking.

title: Human agent support hours
text: Live human agents are available 8 AM to 10 PM IST, all days. Customer care number: 198 (toll-free from Nimbus numbers). Outside these hours, escalated chats receive a callback the next morning.
